div.head: Forf. 2
div.ab: Be forfencge. Embe forfang witan habbað gerǽdd, þæt man ofer eall [Engle]land gelíc[n]e dom healde: þæt is æt men fiftene peningas 7 æt horse healswá, sy hit ofer ane scire, sy hit ofer má, ðe læs ðe unmihtig man feorr for his agenon swince 7 eac to feola sylle.

Of seizure/recovery: Wise men have decreed that throughout all England the same judgement holds: that is, 15 pennies for men and also for horses, be it over one shire or several, lest a man of small means is burdened by long journeys to recover [the objects of] his own labour.[?]

De forefang (id est preuencione uel anticipatione) decreuimus, ut per totam Angliam idem iudicium teneri debeat, hoc est de homine XV denar. et de equo similiter (reddantur), sit ultra unam schiram (unum comitatum), sit ultra plures, ne homo impotens longe pro suo proprio laboret (fatigetur) et etiam nimis det.
